name: genpark-personal-agent-focus-recovery-binaural-beats-skill
description: Calculates Auditory Steady-State Response (ASSR) binaural beat frequencies (40Hz Gamma, 10Hz Alpha, 6Hz Theta) and schedules phased cognitive entrainment protocols.

tools.name: calculate_binaural_entrainment_parameters
tools.description: Calculates left/right ear stereo frequencies and ASSR parameters for brainwave entrainment.

tools.name: schedule_auditory_entrainment_protocol
tools.description: Generates a phased 3-stage binaural entrainment sequence tailored to work session length.
